supersessions.rationale: The replacement applies the uniform conservative rule that pure syntax or punctuation-only physical rows are excluded as formatting, in addition to blank lines, standalone comments and Python docstrings. It adds explicit counted physical line numbers and punctuation exclusions. Candidate identities, source evidence, feature confirmations and all include/unresolved decisions remain unchanged. The predecessor and replacement bytes are both preserved.
supersessions.selection_requirement: Verify both exact predecessor and replacement SHA-256 values, and the rules and candidate-queue bindings, before using the replacement. Do not infer supersession from a filename, recency or overlapping queue ranges.

scope: Source-only review bookkeeping; no DOE outputs, DOE references, model target calls, source changes or frozen v1 mutations.
